paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: The loss comparison between vanilla Transformer and the proposed SepLLM. SepLLM achieves lower loss different computation costs and different training time consistently.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between training time in seconds and the loss value for two different models: ‘Vanilla’ and ‘SepLLM’. The x-axis, labeled “Training Time (s)”, displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 250000 seconds, with tick labels spaced approximately every 50000 seconds. The y-axis, labeled “Loss”, extends from approximately 2.40 to 2.75, with tick marks incrementing by 0.05. The ‘Vanilla’ line, depicted in purple, begins at approximately 2.65 and decreases steadily towards a value of approximately 2.45 over the course of the x-axis. The ‘SepLLM’ line, shown in red, begins at approximately 2.75 and decreases toward a value of approximately 2.48 over the same x-axis.
